records.verificationNote: Read directly from the '2026 California Select Drug List, Four Tier' PDF, effective 08/01/2026 (see saba checkpoint for full source-verification detail). Read the *BIGUANIDES* subsection under *ANTIDIABETICS* (PDF page 31): 'metformin hcl oral tablet 500 mg' Tier 1, QL (5 tablets per 1 day), no PA/ST; 'metformin hcl oral tablet 850 mg' Tier 1 tagged '$0', same QL structure; 'metformin hcl oral tablet 1000 mg' Tier 1; and the extended-release 500/750 mg strengths, all Tier 1 with QL only — confirmed verbatim, no restriction codes anywhere in this subsection. Coverage Requirements and Limits column codes read directly off the document's own KEY (PDF page 14) and the repeated footer legend on every content page: PA=prior authorization, ST=step therapy, QL=quantity limit, DO=dose optimization, BE=benefit exclusion, LD=limited distribution, SP=specialty pharmacy, $0=preventive drug ($0 cost share for qualifying members). Tier 1=lowest cost share (usually generic), Tier 2=higher cost share (preferred brand or newer generic), Tier 3=higher still, Tier 4=highest cost share (specialty). A full-text search of all 116 pages for 'glucophage', 'fortamet', and 'glumetza' (brand metformin/ER names) returned zero hits, confirming the plain generic is the only metformin product carried — no PA barrier exists for this class.
